slides.heading:
Give your child
a head start with money.
slides.copy: Educonomy turns saving, spending, earning and smart choices into an engaging story children will actually enjoy reading.
slides.imageAlt: A tree growing rupee coins above an open book and a stack of coins beside an Ikigyan money pouch.

slides.heading:
One curriculum.
Five real-world subjects.
slides.copy: Financial literacy, mental & emotional wellbeing and digital awareness — taught side by side with physical wellness and social awareness, every week.
slides.imageAlt: A child at a desk looks up thoughtfully, surrounded by five circles representing financial, emotional, physical, social and digital learning.

slides.heading:
26 weeks of Curiosity,
Growth and Discovery.
slides.copy: Two free demo classes to begin. A full year of weekly experiences designed to engage, inspire and empower students.
slides.imageAlt: A winding path connects a school, a calendar, a puzzle book, a globe and a child climbing stairs made of books toward a star.

slides.heading:
Questions worth
staying curious about.
slides.copy: A new fact, question and challenge every week — the kind of thinking that actually sticks.
slides.imageAlt: A telescope, a magnifying glass over a lightbulb, an open book and a hot air balloon circle a large question mark.

slides.eyebrow: A world of discovery, one week at a time
slides.heading:
Curious. Knowledgeable.
Ready for the real world.
slides.copy: Ikigyan helps children discover the world beyond textbooks — through a 26-week learning programme, books, activities and real-world knowledge that stays with them.
slides.imageAlt: A child sits cross-legged on a giant open book, surrounded by a lightbulb, a rocket, a magnifying glass and a globe — imagining beyond the page.
